label: Illustrative example: Meet, with today's meetings and calls, minutes the assistant drafted, and recent recordings with transcripts.
title: Meet
subtitle: Meetings and calls in our own rooms, with colleagues, customers and suppliers.

items.title: Start now
items.body: Your room opens on the waiting screen. Choose camera on, or just your voice, then let people in or share the code.

items.title: Take notes
items.body: For a meeting in the room with you. The assistant listens and gives you minutes, decisions, next steps and drafts to confirm.

items.title: Join
items.body: Type the code from the invitation, or scan the QR code on the host's screen.

items.title: Visit to Tide Street Stores
items.body: The assistant drafted the minutes: a quotation, a message and two tasks wait for your answer.

items.title: Supplier call: Harbour Plastics
items.body: No record yet. The chat and the two files from the room are kept.
